name: Balloon Bobble
description: Keep a balloon aloft, but you lose the use of a limb as time elapses.

name: Hot Potato Tag
description: Tag where the "it" player is eliminated when time is up until only one remains.

name: Cookie Monster
description: Without using your hands, get OREOs from your forehead into your mouth.

name: Junk in the Trunk
description: Shake your booty to dislodge ping pong balls from a container tied to your backside.

name: Tallest Tower
description: Stack foam blocks as high as you can in the allotted time.

name: Banana Belt Bowling
description: Knock pins over using a banana that's dangling from your waist.

name: Try not to Laugh
description: Don't spit water out of your mouth while listening to ridiculous audio tracks.

name: Dizzy Dash
description: Spin round and round and then sprint through several checkpoints.

name: Speed Mölkky
description: Think cornhole mixed with bowling plus an umlaut.

name: Hidden Labyrinth
description: Complete a maze (on paper) with the fewest wall collisions.

name: Card Ninja
description: Embed playing cards into a halved watermelon with the power of your wrist.

name: Balloon Hustle
description: Choose a partner and then be the first to the finish the line while holding a balloon between your foreheads.
